_audit: Landmark tier (the scarce register that drives the scarcity budget) was audited in FULL, all rows, 2026-08-05. Functional/scenic/character-bearing were audited by tag-group sample, not row by row.

map:floodplains/floodplains.json:$.entit.why: Banks sparred_with_relc so the heuristic called it a payoff, but the string IS Relc talking ('Relc whistles...') and delivering the Classes tutorial nudge. map:inn/inn.json:$.entities[29].door_whe.why: A Door of Vines. Banks noticed_the_bare_wall (a flavour/observation counter). The prose is a door opening; the garden reveal beyond it is where the landmark register belongs, and garden_sanctuary owns its own rows.

map:sewers/deep_tunnels.json:$.entities[.why: Warren Mouth. Banks reached_the_warren, but reads as a floor sloping into the next room -- arrival, not payoff.

map:riverfarm/witch_hollow.json:$.entiti.why: A Waiting Pot, the Makings gather (landed by #396 AFTER the landmark tier was audited, which is why the heuristic had no ruling for it and self-test went red). `open_toast` here is the GATED-CONTAINER idiom, not a door: nothing opens and nobody travels. It is chore 1 of 2 in `The Makings`, whose payoff is the kettle lesson in riverfarm_witch.json -- so §4 rule 1 (the CHAIN earns landmark, never the prop) and rule 2 (a banked accomplishment is necessary, not sufficient) both put it below the register, on the same grounds as the three door_when demotions above. It also lands where every other riverfarm work-result toast already sits: the field board, the lamb pen and #396's own winter fold toast are all scenic/quest-prop, and one of the four reading as a payoff purely because its key is spelled `open_toast` was an artefact of the key, not a judgement. NOT A REWRITE -- the string is #396 fresh copy, voice-card adjudicated, and ships byte-as-is. If the controller reads the gather as a genuine beat the fix is a §5 reserve grant (3 left), never an edit.
